text:
Luis: FYI Acme Health just countersigned the MSA but procurement wants compliance artifacts before PO. List: SOC 2 Type II (redacted ok), ISO 27001 cert, pen test attestation, BAA, and a note saying we support audit requests. Also asked for Dedicated pricing and POC runbook.

Priya: Can someone confirm if we can provide SOC2 redacted + an auditor attestation letter? LegalBot, any limits on distribution?

LegalBot: We can provide redacted SOC2 report and a scoped attestation letter. Do not include internal IP addresses or employee PII. Add distribution list to the cover email. BAA template is ready; need customer's signature.

Sam: I'll prepare the POC runbook. Suggested scope: 2-week integration (API keys + sample dataset), 2-week eval (latency & quality). Dedicated config (minimal) I can paste:
```
deploy_mode: dedicated
instance: a100-80gb
pool_size: 2
max_concurrent_requests: 12
reserved_throughput: 500rps
```
Cost estimate: $22k/month committed for that pool, one-time onboarding $4k. If they want single-node smaller pool we can quote $11k/month.

Luis: Procurement prefers line item pricing for committed capacity and an option for burst. Can you provide a brief comparison (committed vs burst) so they can choose?

Sam: Will add a small table (2 bullets) to the packet. Also note: if they require customer-managed keys or Private (VPC) deployment we'll need 3rd-party review and extra lead time.

Priya: For pen test evidence: we can share a vendor-signed attestation letter stating last pentest date and that no critical open findings exist. If they want raw findings we need an NDA + special approval.

Luis: They'll accept attestation per their email. Ask: do we support audit requests (SOC2 auditor calls)? They want confirmation that Redwood will coordinate with their auditor for the scoped services.

LegalBot: We can confirm reasonable cooperation for auditor requests for Hosted and Dedicated services. For Private/on-prem we require separate terms. I'll draft the auditor cooperation clause and add to the packet.

prod-ops: Heads up 1: if POC uses Dedicated in their VPC, ops needs network diagrams and an SSO point of contact. Lead time ~10 business days for network review.

Luis: Action items: Priya to upload redacted SOC2 + pen-test attestation + ISO cert to secure share; LegalBot to attach BAA & auditor cooperation clause; Sam to attach POC runbook + pricing. Target: send packet to procurement@acmehealth.com by EOD Fri.

Priya: On it. I'll post the secure link here once uploaded.

Sam: I'll draft the short pricing comparison & runbook now and post a quick summary for the procurement packet.

Luis: Thanks everyone. We'll loop in the AE to confirm tradeoffs after packet goes out.
